newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos EPS cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said on Wednesday it cut its third quarter estimate for St. Paul Cos Inc, an insurance company, to $1.00 from $1.28 a share.
-- It cut its 1996 estimate to $4.46 from $4.74.
-- This reflects catastrophe losses, especially from Hurricane Fran.
-- On October 1, St. Paul said its third quarter pretax operating earnings will be cut by between $70 million and $75 million due to Hurricane Fran and other storms.
-- EVEREN said its 1997 estimate remains $5.50 a share.
-- "At about $190 million, through only three quarters, 1996 already ranks as the second worst catastrophe year in the company's history," EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN maintains an intermediate-term market perform rating and a long-term outperform rating on St. Paul Cos.
-- St. Paul shares were up 1/8 at 55-3/8 in late morning exchange trading.
